messages.reasoning_content: Contract: offsets in UTF-16 code units; interior start must be rejected, not just moved end backward. Current code: splitPair(end) moves end back — ok. But interior start? It rejects via end<=offset need. Hmm, interior start with enough room would produce text ending mid-pair? If start inside a pair, end>=offset would slice starting mid-pair without error unless end==offset. E.g. offset=1 in a surrogate pair at 0-1, text length 3, max 2 → end=3, end>offset, returns text starting with low surrogate. Contract says reject interior start. So fix: check start not splitting pair → throw 'inspection-range-splits-unicode'.
